questions.background: Fuel prices are a significant economic and political issue globally. Governments often intervene through tax adjustments or subsidies to manage inflation and public sentiment, especially during election periods.

questions.question: The Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) is undertaking Dwarapala restoration work at the Thousand Pillar Temple, located in which district of Telangana?
questions.explanation: The Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) is carrying out Dwarapala (door-guardian) restoration work at the historic Thousand Pillar Temple, which is located in Hanumakonda district of Telangana. Compatible stone matching the original is being selected for replacement or mending.
questions.background: The Thousand Pillar Temple is an ancient Hindu temple built by the Kakatiya dynasty in the 12th century. Restoration efforts by the ASI are crucial for preserving such significant cultural heritage sites, ensuring their structural integrity and historical authenticity.
questions.examRelevance: ASI undertaking Dwarapala restoration at Thousand Pillar Temple in Hanumakonda, Telangana.

source.title: ASI undertakes Dwarapala restoration at Thousand Pillar Temple in Telangana’s Hanumakonda
